name: woocommerce/product-attributes-query
label: Query product attributes
description: Find the global product attributes, such as Color or Size, with their terms. Use include to retrieve specific attribute IDs.

include.description: Limit results to these attribute IDs. Use one ID to retrieve a single attribute.

search.description: Match part of the attribute label or slug, ignoring case.

terms_per_attribute.description: Most terms to return per attribute. Use zero for none.

attributes.description: Returned attributes for the current page.

name.description: Label. Product writes accept it as the name of a global attribute.

slug.description: Taxonomy of the attribute terms, such as pa_color.

order_by.description: Default sort order of the terms.

term_count.description: Number of terms. Use product-terms-query with the slug as taxonomy to page through more terms than terms lists.

total_pages.description: Total number of result pages available for the current query.

per_page.description: Maximum number of items requested per page.

total.description: Total number of matching attributes across all pages.
